title: Works in Tight Spaces
text: Works in Tight Spaces. We've been needing something for the tight space next to our sofa on one end. There's a large book case in that region and that's what I have been using to put my cup on, but it always looks out of place having it on one of the shelves of the book case. This little unit fits easily into that available space. It's not entirely hidden by the bookshelf, but it looks fine. It's definitely easier for me to access my cup than the book shelf. It was quick to put together. It's seems sturdy enough. It's pretty basic, but it does the job.

product_metadata.title: farexon C Shaped End Table, Side Table for Sofa, Couch and Bed, Small Wooden C Table with Metal Frame, Snack Side Table for Living Room, Bedroom and Small Space, Easy Assembly (1 Pack, Grey)
features: 🔋【Sturdy and Durable】- Made of E1 grade high-quality particle board and high-quality metal frame, the sofa end table is not only eco-friendly and safe but also strong and stable, not easy to fall or bend. The coffee table has 2 tiers, the first tier holds 88 lbs and the second tier holds 44 lbs.

🅲【C-Shaped Design】The C-shaped table can easily slide into the bottom of a sofa, bed, or chair for easy access to snacks, drinks, phones, tablets, etc. At the same time, the tight-fitting design also makes it perfect for small spaces. NOTE: The metal base including the lower feet is 1.1" thick.

🔧【Easy to Assemble】The structure is simple, the accessories are marked with numbers, and the package has detailed instructions and tools, you can easily assemble the narrow couch table within 15 minutes. You can also assemble the sofa side table by referring to the installation video on the product page. Dimensions: 10.24"(L) x 13.78"(W) x 23.62"(H).
